title: Протокол за нормативна независимост (ПНИ) — първа техническа проверка
originating_decision: Тестови преписки САМО за тестване. Никога източник за правни правила, предпочитания, прагове или процедурни заключения.

steps: KT83 V1.3 preview regression and syntax
KT83 V1.4 source bias and isolation tests
PNI mandatory SHA and adversarial isolation gate

guarantees_demonstrated: Five normative modules have locked Git-blobs; one-line modifications trigger gate failure until explicit manifest review.
Changing or replacing test fixtures does not alter the normative module fingerprint.
Hardcoded favored article / keyword detector / imports from test fixtures are detected and rejected.
Automatic legal applicability is fail-closed while a complete independent normative conditions graph is missing.
Undocumented changes in the selected protected modules cause automatic CI failure.
Existing stable V27.35 and base KT80 V59.8 have not been modified.
limits: Normative and legal-source completeness cannot be proven from the current 8-article partial V11 register.
Condition AST in stage4 can presently be caller-supplied; not authorized for automatic procedural decisions until independently approved source-to-condition registry is introduced.
CI manifest can be changed intentionally along with sources, requiring human code review / branch protection to make deliberate updates non-bypassable; no repository-wide protection was configured.
Only listed protected modules are hash-frozen; new future modules must be enrolled and reviewed under the PNI.
UI pilot may contain legacy inactive route selector; it is not authoritative evidence of legal result.
This is not a certificate that all legal interpretations are unbiased.
next_required: Expand legal provisions independently from cases, with verified statutory applicability/exceptions and dependencies.
Approve every legal condition against V11 independently of the regression fixture datasets.
Move stage4 rule conditions to approved, immutable rule graph; reject caller-composed condition objects in live engine.
Strengthen GitHub branch controls and review requirements for manifesto/source changes when permissions permit.
Run blind diverse scenario tests: vary dossier titles but preserve facts; vary test fixtures while rules remain byte-identical; verify omission/exclusion coverage.
Only then consider enabling automatic hypothesis and stage5 procedure conclusions and carry out expert acceptance.
